12.title: Ottawa's $493 billion receipt (2025–26)
12.desc:
Where federal spending went in 2025–26, by type.

📊 The numbers (Public Accounts of Canada 2025–26, Vol. II, gross expenditures by type)
• Total: $493.5B, about $11,860 per person ($32.49 a day)
• Transfer payments to people, provinces and programs: $294.1B (60%)
• Federal employees: $67.3B
• Debt charges: $48.3B
• Consultants and professional services: $22.8B

💬 Which line surprised you?

Per person uses Statistics Canada's population on July 1, 2025 (41.6M). Gross expenditures by standard object; items may not add due to rounding.

16.title: Edmonton spread out: 1975 to 2020 from space
16.desc:
How much of the land around Edmonton is covered by buildings, mapped from satellite images, 1975 to 2020.

📊 The numbers (EU Joint Research Centre, GHS-BUILT-S R2023A, 100 m grid; a 60 km square centred on downtown)
• 1975: 84 km² covered by buildings
• 2000: 117 km²
• 2020: 166 km², 97% more than 1975 (nearly double)
• Added 2000–2020: 49 km², vs 33 km² in 1975–2000

💬 Which city should we do next?

How to read it: each 100 m square takes the colour of the first satellite snapshot (1975, 1985, 1990, 2000, 2010, 2020) in which buildings covered 20% of it. The square-kilometre totals add up the full building area of every square, with no threshold. This is the ground under buildings, not the city limits or the metro area. The counter ticks one year at a time and the picture matches each snapshot exactly; between snapshots, that snapshot's new squares appear outward from built land, an illustration of the order, since the year each square was built isn't known.

Sources: Pesaresi M., Politis P. (2023), GHS-BUILT-S R2023A, European Commission, Joint Research Centre (CC BY 4.0). Relief: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (© DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018, provided under COPERNICUS by the EU and ESA). River and lakes: ESA WorldCover 2021 (CC BY 4.0).

18.title: Rent in hours of work: Vancouver 73 hours a month
18.desc:
How many hours do you work just to pay one month of rent?

📊 The numbers (CMHC Rental Market Survey via Statistics Canada 34-10-0133-01; median hourly wage, 14-10-0064-01)
• Vancouver: 73 hours a month in October 2025, about 9 eight-hour days (1997: 53 h)
• Kelowna: 40 h → 65 h since 1997, the biggest jump of 33 cities
• Saguenay: 33 h, the lowest measured
• Edmonton 50 h · Calgary 60 h · Toronto 65 h · Montréal 45 h

💬 How many hours is yours?

Average two-bedroom rent in purpose-built rentals, existing tenants included (new leases are often higher), divided by the province's median hourly wage.

Find your city: https://canadiandataproject.github.io/canada-through-time/#renth-2025
